title: AKS: kubelet identity and node access
summary: Every node pool runs with the cluster's kubelet identity, a user-assigned managed identity in the node resource group. It pulls images from ACR. Any pod that can reach the instance metadata endpoint can request tokens for it too.
notes: The kubelet identity is for the node (image pulls), never for applications. Give apps their own identity through workload identity.
Keep its permissions to AcrPull on the registries the cluster actually uses. Anything more is available to every pod that can reach IMDS.
Block pod access to 169.254.169.254 (network policy, or AKS IMDS restriction where available) for workloads that don't need it.
The control plane has its own separate identity (cluster identity) for managing networking and load balancers.

docs.title: Use a managed identity in AKS
